title: mqtt envelope v1
description: One PROPOSED atom, published by the far end to <prefix>/commands/<ulid> (QoS 1). It travels a broker the host may not own, so it must never carry a credential (auth_slot is a NAME the host resolves). The far end proposes; the host's Policy decides. Unlike git, MQTT carries both atoms: a CALL (the wire's http_request shape) or a seat-addressed CHANNEL command (the wire's bidi_command shape).

ulid.description: Id; also the last topic level (commands/<ulid>, receipts/<ulid>). Idempotency key: a ULID with a retained receipt is never fired again.

seq.description: The far end's monotonic sequence; a gap in receipts tells the far end something was lost.

agent.description: Who proposes — provenance across the boundary; defaults to the far end's node name.

atom.description: Which wire atom the envelope carries. Exactly one of call / channel must be present accordingly.

call.description: atom=call: the CALL atom — identical to the wire's http_request shape (httpx.Request). Fired by the host via the witness (POST /fetch).

url.description: http(s) only. Validate rejects userinfo (user:key@host) and credential-named query parameters (access_key, api_key, token, sig, ...) structurally.

headers.description: ALLOWLIST (internal/guard.RequestHeaderAllow): Accept, Accept-Encoding, Accept-Language, Cache-Control, Content-Type, If-*, Range, User-Agent, X-Request-Id, X-Correlation-Id, X-8-*. Anything else (Authorization, Cookie, X-Api-Key, X-Auth-Token, ...) is rejected by Validate.

channel.description: atom=channel: one CHANNEL command — the wire's bidi_command shape, addressed to a witness SEAT rather than a ws_url (the far end never sees the socket). Fired by the host via the witness (POST /run?session=<seat>).

session.description: Witness seat id (e.g. "fox"); resolved host-side to the held BiDi/CDP socket.

method.description: Command method, e.g. browsingContext.getTree (BiDi) or Page.navigate (CDP).

id.description: Command id to match the response against (default 1).

auth_slot.description: Name of a host-side credential (the host's slots file). The value never enters a topic.

not_after.description: A proposal that sat in the broker past this instant must not fire.

max_ms.description: Fire deadline hint in milliseconds; 0 = host default.

why.description: Free text; echoed into the receipt.
